description: Defines the Base64Attachment class for handling file attachments encoded in Base64 within the OrangeHRM system. Provides methods for managing filename, type, size, and content, including creation from uploaded files and arrays.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a file attachment encoded in Base64, including properties for filename, file type, size, and content, with methods for creation and content management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a Base64Attachment instance with filename, file type, base64 content, and size.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getBase64Content
methods.description: Returns the Base64-encoded content of the attachment.

methods.name: setBase64Content
methods.description: Sets the Base64-encoded content of the attachment.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Decodes and returns the raw binary content of the attachment, or null if decoding fails.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Encodes and sets the raw binary content as Base64.

methods.name: createFromUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates a new Base64Attachment instance from an UploadedFile object, encoding its content to Base64.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a new Base64Attachment instance from an array with keys 'name', 'type', 'base64', and 'size'.
